name: Kaisi Yeh Yaariaan
description: Manik and Nandini's fairy tale love faces shadows that threaten their promised world of light. Can their bond prevail or will it crumble under darkness?

videos.title: Glowing Dreams
videos.overview: Nandini unites two fighting lovers. She fondly collects fireflies believing they're the harbinger of true love. Nandini shifts to Mumbai with Shannoo and Murthy for Rishabh's treatment.

videos.title: Big City Blues
videos.overview: Navya reaches Mumbai to learn singing. Kabir takes a gullible Shahid for a ride and posts his naked images online. The shame and humiliation Shahid receives drives him to kill himself.

videos.title: Life Savers!
videos.overview: Nandini and Navya intervene and save Shahid's life. This incident draws media attention towards the college. The college offers full scholarships to both of them in order to save it's reputation.

videos.title: Nandini And Navya Meet FAB5
videos.overview: Amma Maa implores Nandini to pursue her own dream rather than her father's. This makes Nandini decide to join S.P.A.C.E. where Nandini and Navya meet FAB5 for the first time.

videos.title: Navya Locked in a Garbage Bin
videos.overview: Navya can not believe it when she is invited by FAB5. Instead they lock her up in a garbage bin as a revenge for saving Shahid. Shahid tells Nandini about Kabir's video which shows Navya trapped.

videos.title: Nandini & Navya Get Closer
videos.overview: Nandini saves Navya which enrages the FAB5 even more. This incident stregthens Navya and Nandini's bond. The FAB5 wants Navya to disclose who saved her to be able to join them.

videos.title: Niyonika Manipulates Manik
videos.overview: Nandini and Navya are shocked at their treatment by FAB5. Niyonika uses Manik to get some papers signed by Manik's father. Nandini unknowingly visit's Manik's house. Manik takes her father's pen.

videos.title: Nandini Wants The Pen Back
videos.overview: Nandini and Rishabh jump into the pool to recover the pen. When the pen isn't found, Nandini wants it back from the FAB5. They dare Nandini to do what they say to get her father's pen.

videos.title: Nandini Lashes Out
videos.overview: Nandini hits Manik in an argument. This enrages him. Dhruv asks Manik not to harass Nandini.

videos.title: Friendship's Day
videos.overview: Navya is in a dilemma as her dreams can only be fulfilled by joining FAB5. That would mean ending her friendship with Nandini. Nandini and Manik perform together on Friendship Day.

videos.title: Caught Unaware
videos.overview: Manik takes Nandini to FAB5's friendship day party at his house after the performance at the old age home. Nandini seems delighted to be at the party, but she is unaware of what is to happen.

videos.title: Unacceptable Behaviour
videos.overview: Nandini starts breaking expensive artefacts at Manik's place as she is furious with the FAB5 for having upset her. Manik is upset with Nandini as she behaves that way.

videos.title: The Spot Girl Contract
videos.overview: Manik arrives at Nandini's house. He compels Nandini to sign a contract which will bind her to act as his spot girl. Nandini isn't happy about signing the contract.

videos.title: Nandini is Unhappy With Manik
videos.overview: Manik meets Nandini. He notifies the highlights of the contracts that are the rules which she needs to follow. Nandini feels that Manik is mistreating her.

videos.title: Manik's Merciless Behaviour
videos.overview: Manik makes Nandini perform a series of chores meant for servants. At Dhruv's place, Nandini notices the star which is also drawn on her brother's bedroom wall.

videos.title: Nandini is Suspicious Of Rishabh & Manik
videos.overview: Nandini tries to find out the mystery behind the star's drawing. Rishabh and Manik avoid her. Nandini is suspicious about Rishabh and Manik's behaviour towards her.

videos.title: Dhruv To Rescue
videos.overview: Manik punishes Nandini compelling her to kiss him. He makes her drink a disgusting mocktail. Dhruv stops Nandini from doing it. Nandini is elated as Dhruv comes to her rescue.

videos.title: Defiant Days
videos.overview: Nandini follows Navya's plan to get rid of Manik's torture. Nandini refuses to follow his order. Manik arrives at her place where he notices the star art also to be found at Dhruv's place.

videos.title: Nandini Ends Her Contract With Manik
videos.overview: Alya calls for a FAB5 emergency meeting where they take her side. Alya compels Manik to end his contract with Nandini. Nandini is thankful to Alya to have freed her from the despicable contract.

videos.title: FAB5 Irritates Nandini & Navya
videos.overview: Harshad, Navya, Nandini, and FAB5 are in the same pool but on the opposite ends. FAB5 leaves no opportunity to trouble Nandini and Navya. Nandini and Navya are irritated.

videos.title: Unlikely Trio
videos.overview: Manik comes to meet Nandini at her place to talk about the connection between Dhruv and her brother. Harshad surprises everyone by announcing Navya and Nandini as his band members.

videos.title: Nandini Is In Trouble
videos.overview: Nandini refuses to be a part of Harshad's band. Alya sets Nandini up by having two goons force themselves on her. Nandini is yet to find out that Alya has sent those goons.

videos.title: Manik Regrets His Past Behaviour
videos.overview: Harshad messes up with FAB5 and tries breaking them apart. Mukti calls Alya and tells her that she will commit suicide as the FAB5 has separated. Everyone is worried about Mukti's threat.

videos.title: Threat Fret
videos.overview: Harshad messes up with FAB5 and tries breaking them apart. Mukti calls Alya and tells her that she will commit suicide as the FAB5 has separated. Everyone is worried about Mukti's threat.

videos.title: Stress Test
videos.overview: Harshad protests at the college to revoke Nandini's expulsion order. Manik and Nandini are stressed out on Dhruv's absence in the college. Manik and Nandini contemplate what to do next.

videos.title: Dhruv Knows About Alya's Evil Plans
videos.overview: Harshad compels the FAB5 to leave the practice room. Dhruv spots Alya paying money to the goons for harassing Nandini. Dhruv feels betrayed by Alya, as she hatched a plan against Nandini.

videos.title: Harshad is Worried For Alya
videos.overview: Nandini calls for Manik's help when she is unable to handle Dhruv's strange attacks. Harshad learns that Alya is being blackmailed by a person. Harshad is worried about Alya.

videos.title: Who's She
videos.overview: Nandini informs her uncle and aunt that she has been working in the college cafe. Kabir surprises his gang by introducing his girlfriend to them.

videos.title: Love is in The Air
videos.overview: Raghav calls for a jamming session for the participative bands. While practising, Nandini and Dhruv sneak out to secretly meet each other. Nandini and Dhruv share a good time.

videos.title: Goon Gone Bad
videos.overview: Nandini and Manik get locked in the store room. The goons hired by Alya start harassing her. Manik is worried about Nandini being harassed by the goons.

videos.title: Getting Cornered
videos.overview: Nandini and Manik are locked in the store room. Their respective band members are worried because of their absence. The band members start looking for Nandini and Manik.

videos.title: Lock'n Shock
videos.overview: Nandini and Manik are locked inside the store room till the night. Navya, Harshad and Alya find them. They notice Manik holding Nandini by her waist. Everyone is shocked.

videos.title: Raghav Punishes The FAB5
videos.overview: Nandini and Manik are teased for spending their last night together. Raghav punishes the FAB5, Nandini and Navya by asking them to look for their music instruments hidden in a forest.

videos.title: Treasure Hunt Turns Tragic!
videos.overview: The two bands are engaged in the treasure hunt. Manik and Harshad notice the final treasure. They run for it and accidentally tackle Nandini off the cliff, and chaos ensues.

videos.title: Punishment In Parts
videos.overview: Part one of Raghav's punishment has concluded. Part two consists of the bands performing live that too only with the found instruments. The bands are up for the challenge.

videos.title: Joining Forces
videos.overview: Nandini suggests the two bands to perform together as they had no time left to practise and very less instruments. This manages to impress Raghav.

videos.title: Half Baked Truth
videos.overview: Kabir comes up with a plan to unmask Harshad's true face in front of his band. He partially succeeds. But he also ends up losing trust on one of his own band member.

videos.title: The Hidden Secret
videos.overview: Manik feels betrayed as Dhruv and Alya had kept a huge secret from him. Harshad tries to defend himself in front of his band. The band members are not convinced that easily.

videos.title: Broken Bonds
videos.overview: Manik breaks up with Alya. Dhruv breaks his friendship with Nandini in order to secure his friendship with Manik. Dhruv and Manik try to bond.

videos.title: Fused Together
videos.overview: Raghav makes performing difficult for the band members by asking them to play classical Indian fusion. He also interchanges the members of the two bands.

videos.title: Big Bullies
videos.overview: FAB5 continue to bully Nandini. In the process, they end up hurting her. Dhruv turns out to be the only one mature amongst the arrogant five. He and Nandini become good friends.

videos.title: Competitive Spirit
videos.overview: Harshad calls Navya and Nandini to practise for the competition at his house. Alya calls FAB5 to her home to party. Manik wants Alya to stay away from him until the competition is over.

videos.title: Stranger Than Fiction
videos.overview: Manik overhears Kabir telling Rose to maintain the secret that she's not his girlfriend. Kabir tells the truth. Kabir evades. Both NH3 and FAB5 prepare for a face-off with music.

videos.title: Last Minute Letdowns
videos.overview: Nandini's last-minute persuation gives Navya the impetus to sing in the competition. Manik vanishes moments before his performance as he had to tend to Rishabh who suffers a panic attack at S.P.A.C.E.

videos.title: Letting It Be
videos.overview: Manik stays with Rishabh at the hospital. He performs for FAB5 through his phone. The judges declare NH3 as winners. Dhruv and Manik tide over the minor differences in their friendship.

videos.title: Best Kept Secrets
videos.overview: Manik did not forget Kabir's well-kept secret. He asks Kabir to share it. Manik also threatens Nandini to never tell anyone why he couldn't come to the competition. Navya has a crush on Harshad.

videos.title: Out Of Reach
videos.overview: Manik hides Nandini in his house to avoid his band members discovering her. The band members pour in one by one. Navya is thinking of ways to advance her relation with Harshad.

videos.title: Sneaking Around
videos.overview: With everyone inside the house, Manik tries to sneak Nandini out of his house. She finally manages to exit after every one has passed out. She suggests Manik they should help Rishabh and Dhruv.

videos.title: The Glue Of Love
videos.overview: Navya tells Nandini she is in love with Harshad. Raghav sir asks all of them to prepare for the upcoming music competition. Manik and Nandini join hands to help Dhruv and Rishabh out.

videos.title: Take 2
videos.overview: Alya finds that Mukti has started taking drugs again. Manik once again reminds Kabir to talk about his secret to him but he evades it again. Nandini feels attracted to Dhruv but he doesn't reciprocate.

videos.title: One Step Behind
videos.overview: Navya starts doubting Dhruv and Manik to be gay after she ovearhears their conversation. She tells Nandini about it. NH3 follows every member of FAB5 at every step to know their planning for Musicana.

videos.title: Out In Open
videos.overview: Nandini tells Manik about Harshad's plan. Manik is shocked to know the truth about Kabir which he had kept secret until now. Manik confronts Kabir who confesses about his sexuality.

videos.title: The Right Signs
videos.overview: Kabir tells Raghav that Manik knows about him now. Dhruv tries to learn the signs of true love. Nandini and Manik have found love in each other. Alya decides to get Manik back in her life.

videos.title: Better Avenues
videos.overview: Nandini tells Harshad they should stop following FAB5. Alya encourages Dhruv to confess his love to Nandini. Manik and Nandini come closer to each other every passing day.

videos.title: You & I
videos.overview: Manik asks Kabir who he is dating. Dhruv tells Manik that he's trying to be friends again with Nandini. This makes Manik feel jealous. Everyone come together and celebrate Raghav's birthday.

videos.title: Real Intentions
videos.overview: Kabir and Raghav continue to meet secretly. Alya decides to use Dhruv to get Manik back from Nandini. Mukti cautions Navya about Harshad's real intentions.

videos.title: Tips & Tricks
videos.overview: Alya tutors Dhruv about how to make a girl fall in love with a boy. Nandini can't trace her way back home and stays with Manik. Raghav fears his relation with Kabir will soon be found.

videos.title: Manik & Nandini Gets Close
videos.overview: Nandini is drunk and tries to kiss Manik who stops her and drops her back home. Harshad guises a woman and meets Navya and lures her with his sweet talk. Mukti is in pain and misses Harshad.

videos.title: Kabir & Raghav Are a Couple
videos.overview: Manik teases Nandini by telling her that they got intimate while she was drunk. Manik and gang discover that someone spiked the drinks in the party. Nandini is astounded to learn that Raghav is Kabir's boyfriend.

videos.title: Sparkling Preparations
videos.overview: Nandini tells Manik that Kabir's drink was purposely spiked to know his truth. Manik arranges a special Diwali party where he invites all. Alya preps Dhruv to face Nandini in the party.

videos.title: Boy Interrupted
videos.overview: Shahid interrupts as Dhruv is about to confess his feelings to Nandini at the party. Kabir is worried about Raghav. Manik tells Nandini that he and Alya have parted.

videos.title: Much Too Soon
videos.overview: Mukti hides the fact from Alya that she has resorted to taking drugs. Nandini tells Manik that Kabir and Raghav are a pair. Raghav tells Kabir that they're breaking up.

videos.title: Ricocheting Feelings
videos.overview: Mukti jumps into another relation to get over Harshad. This makes Alya question herself if she will ever forget Manik. Dhruv gets to know that Nandini has made her place in Manik's heart.

videos.title: Eyes Spies
videos.overview: Manik is enraged by the fact that Raghav dumped Kabir. Harshad spies on Kabir and comes to know of his relation with Raghav. Alya voices her concern about Mukti's drug abuse to Manik.

videos.title: Secret Keepers
videos.overview: Kabir thanks Nandini for saving a conflict between Manik and Raghav. She assures that she won't share his secret with anyone. Harshad decides to use Kabir's secret to defame FAB5 before Musicana.

videos.title: Blind Love
videos.overview: Both FAB5 and NH3 put their best feet forward once before Musicana starts. Navya asks Harshad if he really loves her. Dhruv invites Nandini to a special date. She does not know who is behind it.

videos.title: Special Efforts
videos.overview: Nandini arrives at Dhruv's special date without knowing it's planned by him. Alya fails to talk Mukti out of her drug abuse. Dhruv is getting ready to meet Nandini in the special setting.

videos.title: Matter Of Heart
videos.overview: Dhruv tells Manik how he feels about Nandini. Kabir and Raghav are filmed by Harshad. Alya loses hope of getting Manik back. The meeting between Dhruv and Nandini fails.

videos.title: Odd Obsessions
videos.overview: Manik gets obsessed about Nandini after knowing about Dhruv's feelings for her. Harshad prepares to take his revenge on FAB5. He threatens Kabir that he'll play the video during Musicana.

videos.title: Show Stoppers
videos.overview: Manik pretends that his love for Nandini was not real. He shows that it was his revenge for her. Both NH3 and FAB5 put up a great show on the day of Musicana.

videos.title: The Unbreakable
videos.overview: Nandini's performance throws NH3 out of Musicana. Dhruv consoles a heartbroken Nandini. Manik's rejection of her makes her even stronger. She tells Manik he can not break her.

videos.title: Coming Undone
videos.overview: Harshad cuts the rope during Manik's act at Musicana. He is unable to ruin his performance. FAB5 are declared as the winners. Harshad puts Kabir's video on display at Musicana as planned.

videos.title: Nyonika Is Criticised By Her Students
videos.overview: The FAB5 is dumbstruck to learn that Kabir and Raghav dating. Nyonika gets mad at Raghav for his disgusting act. Nyonika is being criticized by the students for her awful speech to cover up the incident.

videos.title: Tipping Over The Edge
videos.overview: The hate boiling between Manik and Harshad tips them over the edge. This leads to a violent fight. Nandini's suspicions prove true. She catches the culprit behind the leaked video.

videos.title: Abhorrent Action
videos.overview: Kabir manages to save his public humiliation at Musicana. Harshad and his men beat Kabir and Raghav outside. Nandini and Manik take Kabir to the hospital. Raghav denies going with them.

videos.title: Undying Faith
videos.overview: Mukti is shattered due to Harshad's video. She goes to meet him. She confesses her love for him. She believes his innocence. They get closer to each other.

videos.title: Battling Envy
videos.overview: Navya and Harshad's intimacy takes a heavy toll on Mukti. Manik battles his jealousy in light of Dhruv and Nandini's growing friendship.

videos.title: Breaking Down
videos.overview: Alya regrets the moments spent with Harshad and cries out hard. Manik calls her and shares the news about Kabir. Kabir's mother learned that he is a gay.

videos.title: Sunny Side Up
videos.overview: Things finally begin looking up for the FAB5 in the form of an unexpected call, after the recent series of bad news. Kabir tells everyone about the offer they have got from the Q Label productions.

videos.title: Unyielding Faith
videos.overview: Navya is not able to accept the fact that Harshad purposely played Kabir and Raghav's intimate video. She thinks Harshad played it mistakenly. Navya is upset.

videos.title: Undesirable Offerings
videos.overview: Dhruv's proposal comes as a shock to Nandini. It makes her remember how Manik destroyed the feeling of love for her. Nandini is upset over Dhruv's proposal.

videos.title: Despicable He
videos.overview: Manik attacks Harshad chilli powder. He then ties and drops Harshad in the water tank to die. Nandini saves Harshad. Everyone is shocked by Manik's despicable act.

videos.title: Alternate Routes
videos.overview: FAB5 think of a plan to teach Harshad a lesson for what he did to Kabir. Nandini intervenes and suggests a plan. No one, except Manik, likes her idea.

videos.title: Complicated Much ?
videos.overview: Nandini's plan is in motion. Harshad has taken the bait. Things become complicated when Harshad comes up with his own plan to teach Manik a lesson.

videos.title: Two Sided Problems
videos.overview: Harshad did everything according to the plan that Nandini had hatched. She is now into deep trouble as Nandini has to manipulate Harshad from two sides.

videos.title: Players Get Played
videos.overview: Manik and Nandini pretend to have fallen in Harshad's trap. In reality, Harshad is the one who is being played. Harshad is unaware of Nandini and Manik's plan.

videos.title: Unrequited Feelings
videos.overview: Nandini and Manik spend the night in the forest. Alya accepts that she is responsible for her breakup with Manik. Dhruv and Alya kiss. Manik accepts the truth about leaving Nandini. Dhruv consoles Nandini.

videos.title: Dropping Off
videos.overview: Manik asks Dhruv to leave the spot as Harshad might see them together. Harshad sends Navya to Manik and Nandini. Kabir's mother drugs him to sleep. Manik drops Nandini and Navya to the hostel. Nandini asks Harshad about his further plan.

videos.title: Changing Perspectives
videos.overview: Navya asks Nandini about how she befriended Manik. Navya tells Harshad about Manik asking Nandini to join Fab5. Mukti tells everyone about Kabir's health. Harshad tells Nandini about the changes in the plan.

videos.title: Reaching Out
videos.overview: Manik tries to apologize to Nandini. Nandini tells Dhruv and others about Harshad's plan. Navya confronts Harshad about their relationship. Manik tries to contact Kabir. Navya calls Nandini.

videos.title: A Fair Warning
videos.overview: Nandini and Alya try to trap Navya and Harshad with their words respectively. Manik asks Nandini to be careful. Harshad overhears Manik and Nandini's conversation. Kabir's mother takes him to the airport.

videos.title: Entrapment
videos.overview: Harshad calls Nandini and asks her to come to the drama room. Dhruv, Alya, and Mukti rescue Kabir at the airport. Harshad confronts Nandini about the truth. Harshad traps Manik in the drama room.

videos.title: Red Handed
videos.overview: Manik asks Nandini to change and run from the drama room. Kabir grabs Harshad's bat. Harshad confesses his crimes which are recorded. Harshad is put into jail for his crimes. Manik and Nandini sign the statement in the police station.

videos.title: Getting Together
videos.overview: Nandini asks Manik to go to a doctor. Kabir teases Manik about Nandini. Nandini consoles Navya. Fab5 decide to have a celebration for their successful plan. Kabir suggests to invite Nandini over for the party.

videos.title: Tell Me More
videos.overview: Kabir teases Manik about Nandini. Mukti and Alya talk about Harshad. Navya remembers her moments with Harshad. Manik opens the champagne bottle. Dhruv tells Alya about Nandini's rejection. Manik asks Nandini to confess her feelings.

videos.title: First Times
videos.overview: Kabir and Nandini talk about their respective feelings. Harshad calls Navya to the jail. Nandini asks Dhruv to drop her home. Mukti and Alya talk about Dhruv's kiss. Manik kidnaps Nandini. The principal calls the Fab5 to the office.

videos.title: Manik Kidnaps Nandini
videos.overview: Kabir and Nandini talk about their respective feelings. Harshad calls Navya to the jail. Nandini asks Dhruv to drop her home. Mukti and Alya talk about Dhruv's kiss. Manik kidnaps Nandini. The principal calls the Fab5 to the office.

videos.title: Taking Sides
videos.overview: Manik tries to woo Nandini into forgiving him. Navya calls Nandini to talk about Harshad. Nandini goes into a room and cries. Kabir calls Manik to tell him about the albums. Navya goes to the police station as a witness for Harshad.

videos.title: Not So Easy
videos.overview: Manik irritates Nandini to get her to talk to him. Nandini tells Manik the truth about her not forgiving him. Manik gets unconscious and falls down. Kabir goes to meet his mother. Nandini takes Manik to the hospital.

videos.title: Sorry Manik
videos.overview: Nandini informs Dhruv about Manik's condition. Doctor tells Manik's friends about the condition of his hand. Nandini apologizes to an unconscious Manik. Alya calls Manik's mother to inform her about Manik's condition.

videos.title: Hard Ground
videos.overview: Nandini checks on Manik in the hospital. Manik's mother goes to meet Harshad in the jail. The doctor gives Nandini and her aunt hopes about Rishabh's condition. Manik's mother comes to meet him at the hospital.

videos.title: Hapless Corners
videos.overview: Manik has a dream about Nandini. Abhimanyu scares Mukti in the children's ward. Navya comes to the hospital to bid Nandini goodbye. Manik is taken for treatment by a specialist. Harshad calls Alya to the jail.

videos.title: Four Walls
videos.overview: Manik's operation is successful. Manik kicks Dhruv out of the room. Dhruv asks Nandini to go to Manik's room. Kabir's mother tries to convince him into staying with him. Nandini goes to Manik's room and does not find him there.

videos.title: Mixed Bag
videos.overview: Nandini and Manik have an argument. Alya goes to the jail to meet Harshad. Nandini's aunt spots Manik in the hospital. Abhimanyu offers to drop Nandini and her family home. Kabir and others plan a welcome for Manik.

videos.title: Back With A Bang
videos.overview: Nandini's aunt asks him about Manik. Fab5 return with a comeback show. Manik is angry with Abhimanyu. Abhimanyu asks Nandini about her and Manik. Nandini goes to the instrument room to play an instrument.

videos.title: Always in Charge
videos.overview: Fab5 decide to perform for Mr. Khurana. Nandini is appointed as the volunteer to welcome Mr. Khurana. Mr. Khurana's daughter tries to convince him to give Fab5 another chance. Harshad calls Alya and shares his emotions.

videos.title: Between The Family
videos.overview: Kabir and Manik talk about the performance. Alya asks Mukti whether Mukti will ever be able to forgive Harshad. Manik and Nandini have a fight. Mukti goes to the rehab. Alya talks to Dhruv about her emotions.

videos.title: In The Zone
videos.overview: Kabir talks to Nandini about him and Raghav. Manik and Kabir share their emotions. Manik's mother calls Mr. Khurana and asks him to appoint a manager for Fab5. Soha suggests that everyone should party to celebrate.

videos.title: Dhruv Bats For Harshad
videos.overview: Dhruv asks Manik to forgive Harshad. Soha tries to flirt with Manik in the music library. Mukti is angry with Abhimanyu. Manik tries to make Nandini feel jealous by talking about Soha. Dhruv tries to convince everyone to forgive Harshad.

videos.title: The Blame Game
videos.overview: Fab5 fights over the Harshad issue. Everyone blames eachother. Nandini shares her feelings with Abhimanyu. Soha goes to Manik's house to surprise him. Nandini reaches Manik's house too out of jealousy.

videos.title: Hidden Agendas
videos.overview: Manik flirts with Soha as he knows that Nandini is hiding there. Dhruv explains to Alya why Kabir and Mukti are so upset. Manik tries to find Nandini in the house. Nandini texts the Fab5 to come to Manik's house.

videos.title: Patching Up
videos.overview: Kabir finds Nandini at Manik's house. Fab5 come together and patch up. Fab5 go to the police station to take their case back. Abhimanyu meets Nandini in the college. Nandini does her job as the manager for Fab5.

videos.title: Seeds Of Doubt
videos.overview: Manik confronts Nandini about the previous night. Alya gives Dhruv a gift. Kabir and Manik talk about Nandini. Manik flirts with Soha to make Nandini jealous. Navya returns to S.P.A.C.E. Nandini gets angry with Manik because of Soha.

videos.title: Emotions At Large
videos.overview: Nandini gets irritated and calls Manik. Mukti asks Abhimanyu for a date. Kabir misses his mother. Navya goes to the police station to find Harshad. Everyone goes to the party. Kabir teases Nandini about Manik.

videos.title: Frenemies
videos.overview: Manik comes to know about Nandini's plan. Soha asks Dhruv to call Manik. Kabir covers for him. Manik gets angry with Nandini when she throws the gift out of the window. Harshad comes to the party. Navya and Harshad talk.

videos.title: A New Year
videos.overview: Soha gets impatient waiting for Manik at the party. Soha tracks down Manik from Kabir's phone. Everyone celebrates New Year. Soha comes to know about Manik and Nandini. Harshad gets tensed about Navya.

videos.title: Short Fused
videos.overview: Kabir drops Nandini to her house. Harshad apologizes to Navya over the phone. Alya is angry with Harshad for crashing the party. Soha tries to spoil Manik and Nandini's relationship. Nandini thanks Abhimanyu for the arrangements.

videos.title: Anger Galore
videos.overview: Nandini and Manik spend some time in the music room. Soha plans a photoshoot for Fab5. Harshad brings Navya to the hospital for examination. Manik and Nandini fight with each other. Manik is angry with Soha.

videos.title: Everybody Talks
videos.overview: Manik angrily goes away from the photoshoot. Manik and Nandini talk about their problems. Navya reveals the truth about Harshad on a mike. Nandini consoles Navya. Soha plans an accident for Nandini.

videos.title: Ups & Downs

videos.title: Alya Wants To Quit
videos.overview: Manik plans a surprise for Fab5. Everyone tries to cheer Alya. Alya has another stress burst and decides to leave Fab5. Aryaman tricks Nandini into thinking that he just wants to be a friend.

videos.title: All Will Be Well
videos.overview: Kabir tries to be optimistic about Alya's stress burst. Dhruv also leaves Fab5. Manik is in a shock. Kabir and Mukti try to talk to Manik. Kabir and Mukti tell Nandini that everything is fine.

videos.title: Here & There
videos.overview: Manik tells Nandini that he cannot share his problem with her. Kabir follows Dhruv to the club. Alya thinks about her time with Fab5. Nandini takes Aryaman to the doctor.

videos.title: Things That Matter
videos.overview: Dhruv gets ready to perform in the club. Nyonika spies on Aryaman. Manik feels emotional due to the fight. Nandini stays back with Aryaman at the hospital. Manik reaches the hospital.

videos.title: Domino Effect
videos.overview: Aryaman's plan fails. Kabir comes to Dhruv's rescue at the club. Mukti tries to talk to Alya about Fab5. Kabir also tries to do the same. Manik comes to know the truth about Aryaman.

videos.title: Truth Prevails
videos.overview: Manik catches Nyonika and Harshad together in the bed. Kabir tells Navya about Dhruv's decision. Kabir and Mukti find the truth about the club. Manik reveals the truth about Soha to Aryaman.

videos.title: Sharing Is Caring
videos.overview: Kabir and Mukti go to the airport to reveal Harshad's plan to Dhruv. Nandini tries to console Manik. Kabir shares his feelings with Navya. Harshad goes to meet Mukti.

videos.title: Wishful Thinking
videos.overview: Manik wishes Nandini goodluck for the competition. Nandini prays to god for Fab5. Badshah comes and performs. Aryaman apologizes to Manik for his mistake.

videos.title: Getting It Right
videos.overview: Nandini, Navya, and Aryaman perform in the talent hunt. Everyone is excited about Fab5's performance. Fab5 have an argument again. Manik tries to explain how important this competition is for them.

videos.title: Spoilt Sport
videos.overview: Fab5 go on the stage and perform. Harshad tries to spoil Fab5's performance. Fab5 win the talent hunt. Aryaman invites everyone to his home for a party. Nyonika and Aryaman have a conversation.

videos.title: Up To The Test
videos.overview: Dhruv comes to Nandini's house to apologize to her. Rishabh has an attack once again. Dhruv explains about Rishabh's condition. Navya and Kabir interview parents for the adoption of the baby.

videos.title: Sorry Seems To Be The Hardest Word
videos.overview: Kabir's mother comes to meet him and apologize. Dhruv comes and apologizes to everyone. Manik and Nandini spend romantic time with each other.

videos.title: Getting Together
videos.overview: Dhruv apologizes to everyone. Nandini remember her moments with Manik. Alya goes to Aryaman's house to help him. Manik and Kabir reach Aryaman's house for the party.

videos.title: The Big Bang
videos.overview: Nyonika asks the driver about Nandini. Navya, Kabir and Mukti reach the party. Aryaman apologizes to everyone. Nandini tells Rishabh about the party. Kabir and Manik get into an accident. The car blasts.

videos.title: Manik's Birthday Celebration
videos.overview: Navya is doing great at her job but her boss is not happy with her. Nandini sends messages to the team mates to inform them about Manik's birthday celebration which puts them in a fix.

videos.title: Nandini Wants Reunion Of Friends
videos.overview: Manik's birthday celebration is Nandini's attempt to reunite the FAB5. Harshad burns down the bribe offered by Nyonika. Nandini plays a prank in order to make Mukti, Navya and Alya attend the party.

videos.title: FAB5 Enemy, Maddy Enters
videos.overview: The FAB5 is shocked to hear Maddy playing Manik's favourite tune. Next day on the 'Rakshabandhan' festival, Alya doesn't tie the band on Harshad's hand as she's disgusted by his deeds.

videos.title: Mukti Wants To Thrash Maddy
videos.overview: Agitated with Maddy, Mukti decides to hit him with her bike, Nandini stops her. Mukti and Alya convince Maddy to join them in the jam in session. Maddy manages to dodge them.

videos.title: Space Academy Presidential Election
videos.overview: Harshad and Nandini are announced as the candidates for the President's post. Maddy tries convincing Nyonika to let him contest. Harshad blackmails Nyonika to make him the President.

videos.title: Maddy Is Threat To Nandini
videos.overview: Maddy loses the first competition to Nandini. Mukti takes all her frustration out on little Abeer. Dhruv is ready with a song but is upset with his team mates for not supporting him.

videos.title: Presidental Elections Commence
videos.overview: Manik, Mukti, and Alya console each other. Navya gives Sahil the permission to spend some time with Abeer. Harshad makes Alya realise her feelings for Varun.

videos.title: Nandini Challenges Maddy
videos.overview: Nandini asks Maddy to put cow dung on his face if she wins the elections.

videos.title: Rebellious Mukti
videos.overview: Dhruv informs his friends that FAB5 has been banned from O2. Mukti rebels against her owner's conventional thoughts.

videos.title: Harshad Conspires Against Maddy
videos.overview: Harshad deletes Maddy's records from the data room to pull him out of election and Nandini finds his records.

videos.title: Dhruv Wants Alya's Support
videos.overview: The election results are going to be announced in Space Academy, Dhruv wants Alya to motivate him to dance.

videos.title: Nandini's Attempt To Reunite FAB5
videos.overview: Nandini tries to reunite the team FAB5 for the Talent Hunt being held in the Academy, but fails. She recalls her passion for music and takes part in the competition.

videos.title: Maddy Torment's Nandini
videos.overview: Maddy stops his performance after he notices Ustaad Mukesh; he is invited by Nandini. Maddy torments Nandini by singing Manik's song.

videos.title: Maddy Locks Nandini
videos.overview: Maddy locks Nandini up in the music room and leaves. Her friends rescue her and try really to cheer her up.

videos.title: Rishabh Starts Speaking
videos.overview: Nandini figures out that Rishabh is with Maddy and she rushes to Maddy's house. Maddy's song makes Rishabh speak which overwhelms Nandini. The secretary helps Navya and Mukti cure Abeer.

videos.title: Nandini Delcared As President Of Space Academy
videos.overview: Nandini wins the Presidential elections of Space Academy. After much partying, the Fab Five get a note from the society asking them to empty the flat. The next day, Nandini hears Nyonika talking about the Fab Five being warned and not banned.

videos.title: FAB5 Gets Banned
videos.overview: Nandini is informed that FAB5 has been banned by Nyonika. Mukti decides to apply for Abeer's adoption.

videos.title: Navya Upset With Mukti Over Adoption
videos.overview: Navya is upset with Mukti for having posted an advertisement for Abeer's adoption.

videos.title: Nyonika Suspends Nandini
videos.overview: The cops visit Mukti and Navya for the interrogation related to Abeer. Nandini and Aryaman finds the details of the driver.

videos.title: Mukti & Navya Saved From Cops
videos.overview: The driver escapes before Nandini and Aryaman find him. The society chairman saves Mukti and Navya from the cops and reminds them that they need to vacate the house.

videos.title: Maddy Saves Nandini
videos.overview: Maddy saves Nandini from an accident, Nyonika threatens Harshad for his involvement. Dhruv explains to his friends that the Band's success was Manik's dream.

videos.title: Harshad At His Best
videos.overview: Nandini is informed that O2 wants FAB5 to perform. Harshad creates misunderstanding between the team mates by accusing Aryaman for the blast.

videos.title: Aryaman Held Responsible For Blast
videos.overview: All the evidence are against Aryaman and the teammates have no option but to hold him responsible for the blas.

videos.title: Nyonika, The Culprit!
videos.overview: Aryaman finds the driver, who reveals that Nyonika paid him to plant the bomb in the car.

videos.title: Aryaman Threatens Harshad
videos.overview: Nandini is informed that Nyonika resigned from her post, Aryaman threatens Harshad to stay away from Nandini.

videos.title: Maddy Interrupts FAB5 Jam Session
videos.overview: Their jam-in session is interrupted by Maddy as he informs them that he has allotted the music room to another team for practice.

videos.title: FAB5 In Search Of Lead Singer
videos.overview: The FAB5 is not allowed to perform without Manik at the O2 recording. The team decides to find their lead singer and find Maddy having the same voice as Manik.

videos.title: Maddy Rejects FAB5's Offer
videos.overview: Maddy rejects the offer to become the lead singer of FAB5. Nandini reminds him about his promise to support FAB5.

videos.title: Nandini's Nasty Comment
videos.overview: Navya receives a call for Abeer's adoption. Maddy is restless because Nandini called him an imposter. Nandini finds a band that she gifted to Manik.

videos.title: Nandini Break's Down Remembering Manik
videos.overview: Ustaad Mukesh asks Maddy to join him in the Kerala trip. Navya hosts the upcoming show of FAB5.

videos.title: Manik Has A Look-Alike
videos.overview: A guy who looks like Manik is seen listening to FAB5. Maddy is irritated by Ustaad's decision to not let him pursue rock music.

videos.title: Maddy Saves FAB5
videos.overview: Maddy enters when it's the singer's turn in the performance and saves FAB5. Manik returns and is upset to witness Maddy on the stage.

videos.title: Manik Is Alive !
videos.overview: Nandini and friends are startled to see Manik playing guitar in the music room, they are ecstatic to see him alive.

videos.title: Nandini's Sweet Attempt
videos.overview: Maddy taunts his grandfather by telling him about his mind boggling rock music performance. Nandini meets Manik and consoles him.

videos.title: FAB5 Finally Reunites
videos.overview: The FAB5 team has finally united. Ustaad Mukesh disowns Maddy because he chose rock music over classical music.

videos.title: Manik's Jealousy
videos.overview: Aryaman offers Maddy to stay with him. The FAB5 is celebrating Manik's return and they think about Kabir. Manik is jealous as Aryaman gets close to Nandini.

videos.title: A Wish From The Bucket list
videos.overview: During the game, Aryaman's closeness toward Nadini makes Manik jealous. They sneak out from the group and spend some romantic moments together.

videos.title: A Business Proposal For Madhyam
videos.overview: While Alya, Dhruv, and Mukti are busy discussing their future, Madhyam is approached by a businessman who wants him to sing in one of the upcoming events.

videos.title: Maddy Humilates Manik
videos.overview: Manik comes to know that Maddy is responsible for Steve's recovery. Maddy replaces Manik's position in the band and humiliates him for it. Meanwhile Mukti convinces Navya to give Abeer up for adoption.

videos.title: Madhyam Keeps An Eye On FAB5
videos.overview: Madhyam tells Nandini that he will keep an eye on the FAB5. He also accepts the businessman's deal. Navya tests the capability of Sahil and Kiran if they want to adopt Abeer.

videos.title: Manik Confronts Maddy For Stealing FAB5's Song
videos.overview: Manik gets angry at Maddy for stealing the FAB5's song and Navya agrees to give her baby up for adoption. Later, Manik and Nandini spend some romantic moments together.

videos.title: Manik Gets His Band To Perform
videos.overview: Bhai questions Alia's passion for music. Meanwhile Manik's influence gets his band the chance to perform at the event.

videos.title: Maddy Loses To Manik In Challenge
videos.overview: Maddy loses to Manik in the guitar solo challenge. He also offers to perform for free and requests the organizers to cancel their contract with Manik.

videos.title: The Stage Fight
videos.overview: For his own benefit, the businessman tries to showcase both the performances but unfortunately Maddy and Manik start fighting on the stage.

videos.title: Manik's Head Injury
videos.overview: The Doctor reveals Manik's injury, this makes the FAB5 and Nandini worried. They decide to take revenge on Maddy. Meanwhile Navya checks the capabilities of Abeer's adoptive parents.

videos.title: Revival Of Love On Diwali
videos.overview: Manik and Nandini revive their love on the occasion of Diwali. Meanwhile Maddy refuses to accept Nandini's apology.

videos.title: Harshad Becomes President
videos.overview: Manik and his friends are shocked at seeing Harshad as the new president of Space Academy. Meanwhile Nandini presents Manik his old guitar as a Diwali gift and asks him to complete the song.

videos.title: Nandini & Manik Get Romantic
videos.overview: While everyone is celebrating Diwali, Manik and Nandini find a romantic spot to spend the time together. Harshad provokes Aryaman so much that he reveals his love for Nandini.

videos.title: Harshad & Manik Talk
videos.overview: Harshad challenges Manik for the upcoming Musicana festival. Harshad taunts him that the FAB5 do not have a drummer after Cabir's death. Harshad suggests that Manik add Aaryaman to his band.

videos.title: Manik Livid With Nandini Because Of Aryaman
videos.overview: Manik is furious at Nandini for showing up late because of Aryaman. Navya is becoming dubious about Sahil and Kiran. FAB5 breaks down while playing Kabir's tune.

videos.title: Sahil Spotted With His Boyfriend
videos.overview: Manik fulfils one wish from Nandini's bucket list; they notice Sahil hugging a guy inside a car. The guy is Sahil's boyfriend, but Sahil cleverly lies to them.

videos.title: Revelation About Sahil
videos.overview: Nandini is restless and Manik tells her to relax. Later, they inform Navya that Sahil is gay and that they are concerned about Abhir's future.

videos.title: Sahil Has A Boyfriend ?
videos.overview: Alya comes with Raima's footage to show it to everyone. Manik informs them that Sahil has a boyfriend and Kiran isn't his wife.

videos.title: FAB5 Find Out About Shail & Kiran
videos.overview: The FAB5 and Nandini find out about Sahil and Kiran's true colours and realize that Sahil is homosexual. In the meantime, Harshad requests Aryaman to join his band.

videos.title: Dhruv Breaks Up With Alya
videos.overview: Aaryaman explains to Nandini about his changed behavior towards her. Meanwhile, Dhruv realizes that Alya would be happier with Varun and decides to leave her.

videos.title: Dhruv Expresses His Anguish To Alya
videos.overview: Nandini and Manik spend time with a prostitute and make her feel special. Dhruv expresses his anguish to Alya and decides to move on in life. Meanwhile, Manik, Nandini and Mukti console Alya.

videos.title: Where Has Dhruv Gone ?
videos.overview: hruv has suddenly cut off from everyone and disappeared. FAB5 is shattered by this. They reminisce his memories.

videos.title: Kiran Tries To Convince Navya
videos.overview: Manik faints recalling something of the accident. Sahil's boyfriend, Kiran meets Navya to convince her. He even calls on her show to ask for a solution.

videos.title: Can FAB5 Impress Ustaad Mukesh ?
videos.overview: Harshad announces the music mentor of college, Ustaad Mukesh. He announces that there will be a music competition. FAB5 is worried as they are aware that Mukesh hates them.

videos.title: FAB5 Face The Challenge Heads On
videos.overview:
Everyone but Dhruv decide to stay confident and face the challenge. Mukesh starts with the first Qualifier Round where the students give their solo performances.

What's Up Next?

videos.title: Mukti, Manik & Alya Confront Ustaad
videos.overview: Ustaad Mukesh got everyone through the first round except Mukti, Manik, and Alya. This agitates them; they go and confront him.

videos.title: Nandini Tries To Cool Down Manik
videos.overview: Manik hurts himself in anger; Nandini tries to console him. Varun calms Alya down. Mukti and Alya try making Manik realise that they aren't accepting the facts.

videos.title: Love Is Blooming
videos.overview: Manik, Mukti, and Alya console each other. Navya gives Sahil the permission to spend some time with Abeer. Harshad makes Alya realise her feelings for Varun.

videos.title: Competition Time
videos.overview: Nandini has been asked to take care of Manik by his doctor. Mukesh decides to hold another competition between the selected candidates.

videos.title: Manik Is Prone To Severe Diseases
videos.overview:
Ustaad Mukesh isn't happy with the music students. Varun teases Alya as he feels that she's attracted to him. Nandini learns that Manik is prone to Alzheimer or partial Amnesia.

What's Up Next?

videos.title: Nandini Is Lost In Curing Manik
videos.overview: Nandini hides the truth from Manik and tells him that the stress is making him forget things. Navya motivates Mukti to grab the opportunities coming her way. Ustaad Mukesh scolds Nandini.

videos.title: Nandini Is In Fix
videos.overview: Nandini is given another chance by Ustaad Mukesh. Navya decides to give Kiran and Sahil a second chance to win her confidence. The doctor informs Nandini that Manik's case is getting complicated.

videos.title: Manik Consoles Nandini
videos.overview: Manik tells Nandini that it shouldn't bother her if someone dislikes her. All the students are given a task to create music with the help of nature. They are restricted from using musical instruments.

videos.title: Manik Is Upset About His illness
videos.overview: Manik has a rare mental disease. He is losing his memory. As he returns home, Nandini tries cheering him up as she finds him a bit upset.

videos.title: Manik Talks About His Condition With Nandini
videos.overview: Manik tries explaining to Nandini about the disease from which he is suffering. Ustaad Mukesh sets up a test in the class which qualifies the students for the competition.

videos.title: Alya's Face-Off With Varun
videos.overview: Nandini and her friends qualify for the 'Music Gana'. Alya confronts Varun about him cheating on her.

videos.title: Aryman Shares His Feeling
videos.overview: Nandini has arranged a party. Aryaman confesses his feelings for Nandini. Nandini tells everyone that Manik is suffering from partial amnesia.

videos.title: Manik & Nandini's Eternal Love Story
videos.overview: Revisit the eternal love story of Manik and Nandini. Here's how it all began and flourished into the love story of a lifetime. If anyone gave all of us relationship goals, it was this adorable jodi of Manik and Nandini.

videos.title: 'Will You Marry Me?'
videos.overview: Here's the moment we've all been waiting for - the most romantic proposal ever! And guess what? It's Nandini taking the lead. Will Manik be swept off his feet?

videos.title: Relationship Status: It's complicated
videos.overview: From being committed to it's complicated, Nandini and Manik's relationship status has changed dramatically! Will love get another chance?

videos.title: Conscious Uncoupling
videos.overview: Manik is giving exclusive dating tips to Nandini! Does Manik want to push Nandini away just so he can move on?

videos.title: The Date War
videos.overview: The war between Nandini and Manik just got real and it's all going down at Mukti's engagement party. Nandini's date? Safe and dependable Smaran. Manik's date? The wild and seductive Inaya!

videos.title: Nothing hurts quite like love
videos.overview: Memories don't heal what's broken but even 'unfollowing' doesn't confirm a break-up! It's not over till it's really over!

videos.title: Love or just hand in glove?
videos.overview: It's Mukti's Mehendi ceremony and our bride has come up with the perfect plan to fix #MaNan forever. Will Mukti's ploy work? Will Manik and Nandini finally be able to sort things out?

videos.title: Hold me love, one last time
videos.overview: No matter how much they try, Manik & Nandini just cannot live without each other. Witness the classic tug of war of MaNan wala love right here.

videos.title: Sometimes, love is just not enough
videos.overview: Just when we thought that an intimate night might change things between #MaNan, a shocking confession from Manik almost blows their world apart!

videos.title: If storms don't last forever, can love?
videos.overview: By breaking up, Manik just wanted to protect Nandini. But there is a glimmer of hope on the heartbreak horizon. Is it time for a #MaNan reboot?

videos.title: It's raining love
videos.overview: While their world crumbles around them, Manik and Nandini are holding on to each other just a little longer! Will this #SizzleInTheDrizzle change things?

videos.title: Dream a little dream with me
videos.overview: What happens when Manik and Nandini must pretend to be a married couple? Hint: It's the #MaNan feels all over. Watch their love bloom and HOW!

videos.title: Truth over love?
videos.overview: Nandini is about to drop a bomb on Manik, knowing fully well that she might lose him forever! Can love survive a falsehood?

videos.title: Is love in the pyaar, forever?
videos.overview: They fought in love, they lost in love, they almost found heaven on earth! Such is the circle of #MaNan love. But the big question still remains - will they have their happily-ever-after?

videos.title: Kuch Baaki Hai
videos.overview: Two years after promising each other 'hum', Manik and Nandini are distinctly 'main' and 'tum'. But when fate makes their paths cross once more, will they give love another chance?

videos.title: Monster! Monster!
videos.overview: To defeat the wicked witch Nyonika, Manik is forcing Nandini to stay by his side. Will she give in to his demands? Or will Nandini walk away from Manik once and for all?

videos.title: Home Coming
videos.overview: Nandini moves in with Manik, but the past still haunts them. Can they find peace or will their shared pain overwhelm them?

videos.title: Old Habits
videos.overview: Annoyed by Manik's attempts to force her hand, Nandini plans a party to exact her revenge. Is the night headed for a disaster? Or is this the first thaw in the ice between #MaNan?

videos.title: Hum Kho Gaye Kaahan
videos.overview: Broken dreams leave scars, just like broken glass. Can Manik and Nandini mend their wounds and find solace in each other?

videos.title: Sea Glass
videos.overview: Delving into Nandini's memories, we learn what had gone wrong between her and Manik seven months ago.

videos.title: Hi, New Neighbour!
videos.overview: When dealing with Sehar and her baby, Manik reveals a side of him that was previously unknown to even Nandini. Was she wrong about Manik all along?

videos.title: Savera Ho Raha
videos.overview: Nandini's quest for answers leads her to the place where it had all gone wrong. We finally discover Manik's side of the story.

videos.title: Surprise Gone Wrong
videos.overview: Nandini and Manik reunite, yearning for a fresh start. But can a special night truly erase their painful past?

videos.title: I Am The Monster!
videos.overview: Nandini's secret threatens Manik's love. Can their bond withstand the truth she reveals?

videos.title: Nyonika Ka Khabri
videos.overview: Manik and Nandini, with their secrets exposed, yearn for a fresh start. But a hidden enemy threatens their future. Can they uncover the spy before it's too late?

videos.title: Noor Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: Manik takes Noor for her vaccination, hoping it will help Seher concentrate on her music. Will this outing stir painful memories or create new ones for MaNan?

videos.title: Teri Meri Roohdaariyaan
videos.overview: Harmony reigns in Manik and Nandini's lives, with Musicana approaching. Is this the calm before the storm, or are MaNan's troubles truly over?

videos.title: We Are In Deep Trouble
videos.overview: SPACE Goa's fate hangs in the balance as Vibe's big night arrives. Manik and Nandini must face their inner demons before they can save the day.

videos.title: Secrets And Confessions
videos.overview: Manik and Nandini confront their hidden truths, thanks to Vibe's intervention. But Seher's proposition throws them back into familiar uncertainty.

videos.title: The Trinity
videos.overview: Manik and Nandini rebuild their shattered dreams, creating a more beautiful future. But can they achieve ultimate happiness together?
